serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: Welcome back. I wonder if Annalie already met with my neighbor. It hasn't been long since I spoke with her about it, but their meeting should have already happened if she had decided to meet him. She didn’t call any of us for help, so I guess she survived. I worried a little since I don’t know much about that guy. I hope it went without any accident. You: Hello, Annalie. How did it go? Lady Annalie: Pretty good! He’s a really nice, stand-up guy. You: Wow, that’s unexpected. I didn’t think he would get such a high price from you. Lady Annalie: Don’t judge a book by its cover. Lady Annalie: Well, it took some hard work to bring his spirits up, but I didn’t mind doing it at all. You: Uh, what do you mean by that? #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Oh, I think you exactly know what I mean~ #Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: N-No, not really. What? She can’t be serious… She didn’t- She wouldn’t do it with a guy like that, right? Lady Annalie: Come on, are you really asking for details? I guess I wouldn’t mind sharing some of it with you, but it’s quite a surprise that you are into something like that. You: W-Wait a minute! You were only supposed to cheer him up a little! Lady Annalie: Oh, I think I did a pretty good job with that, but he was pretty cute so, you know, one thing led to another and accidentally we went all the way~ You: Wha- {{wi}}You wouldn’t- {{wi}}With him? {{wi}}Why? How?! #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.pervy Lady Annalie: {{punch}}Buahahahaha! Gotcha! Lady Annalie: Oh man, if you could only see your face~ Hilarious! Jokes like that… Don’t play with my feelings so much Annalie!!! You: Come on… #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: Wow, I did expect you to be surprised, but I clearly saw there a hint of jealousy~ I think I’m gonna tell on you to your girl~ You: Please don’t do that, that could mean the end of me… Lady Annalie: I can’t believe you fell for it so hard~ You: Alright, I admit it, you got me. Can you tell me how it really went down? #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: I guess I can. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised Lady Annalie: At first it wasn’t that bad. Sure, he was shy and a little awkward, but in the middle of the “date” he started crying… Lady Annalie: I wanted to cheer him up somehow since he was making a scene and everyone in the restaurant was looking at us, but when I went for a gentle pat on the back he leaned in for a hug. I dodged it, but his disgusting drool got on my new dress. You: Yikes. Lady Annalie: It fucking sucked. I hope you will at least pay me for the dry cleaning.
